scope: Independent exact initial unbound source-only review, with synthetic inert observations only

findings.detail: Optimization removes assertion-based bounds and format/currentness checks. Independent -O inert control accepted one tiny synthetic entry despite member cap zero (still ready:false). Add non-assert module guard before imports or explicit checks; no caller escape.

O_RDONLY opens before confirming regular type. Named FIFO or replacement FIFO can block before deadline. Require regular current-owned single-link pre-lstat with same post-open inode/identity, O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK, and start monotonic before opening. No blocking FIFO attempted.

Version regex excludes literal backslash (confirmed), but permits malformed epoch or empty Debian revision; synthetic 1::garbage and 1.2- projected. Use bounded conservative Debian Policy 5.6.12 version components without a new subprocess, and verify package/version exact negative/positive behavior.

An archive regular status member underneath a symlink/non-directory ancestor is not a faithful rootfs status projection. Verify any explicit targeted parent entries are unique ordinary directories regardless of archive order; reject non-file header sizes and avoid accepting Linux path aliases. Remains non-extracting.

Full lstat timestamp/size/link parent stamps detect even unrelated sibling writes; safe refusal, but noisy in workspace. Canonical type/dev/ino/uid parent identity plus full artifact stamps can refuse replacement without treating harmless same-directory activity as file replacement.

inspect_unverified accepts a caller parser injection as an inert test seam and verifies no signer. Future binding must use exact hash-pinned load_paragraphs and genuine independently verified signature chains; no authority follows from caller-pinned receipt, and CLI remains deliberately unbound.
